AnswerWaitEnd.description: Why a letter stopped waiting for an answer nobody gave.

oneOf.description: The sender's or the recipient's registration ended.
The letter was sent 24 hours ago and no answer came.

BellFailure.description: A bell that failed: the doorbell's code for it, and whether the engine had been asked to type the line, so it may be in the agent's input (`docs/delivery.md`, Letters while the agent works). A failure that typed nothing after one that may have keeps that one's `maybe_typed` and time: the line it may have typed is still where it was.

BellTurn.description: The native session and submitted bell digest that own this intake.

Folded.description: One sender's folded letters in a bundle.

answer_wait_ended.description: Set when the wait for an answer ended without one; null otherwise.

bell_ended.description: The bells whose result the store recorded: the doorbell rings a letter one bell at a time and records how each ended (typed, failed, or held after its reservation) before it reserves the next, so a result ends the bell reserved last. Fewer than `bell_attempts` while a bell is on its way. Null on a letter an earlier build rang, which kept no such count; an older build drops the field at its next save.

bell_failure.description: Why the letter's last bell failed, while no bell typed after it went through; absent otherwise. Its sender reads the cause here, and the doorbell reads whether the line may be in the agent's input. An older build drops the field at its next save.

bell_line.description: The line the doorbell typed for this letter last, saved with its reservation before it was typed; null until the first bell. A submitted prompt is that bell when its canonical digest matches this line; older hooks' whole-line digests remain accepted too.

bell_route.description: How the last bell was sent (`delivery::ladder`), which words its unconfirmed notice; the recipient's record confirms it either way.

bell_typed_at_unix_ms.description: When the doorbell last typed this letter's bell into its recipient's pane (`agent.prompt` answered); the recipient's own record of the prompt confirms it (`delivery::typed`). Null until a bell was typed.

forced.description: Sent with `hide request send --force` (PRD engine-bundle-1 D-14): its composer was read empty when it was sent, and the doorbell types its bell even while the recipient works, after reading the composer empty once more; a composer that shows text then leaves it an ordinary letter sent with `--now`. An older build drops the field and the letter waits as a `--now` letter.

handed.description: A prompt hook of the recipient's own session asked with the bell line's digest and was handed the letter's body to print. No bell is typed for it again, whether or not the hook's confirmation arrived (`delivery::doorbell`): the next bell's batch for the same recipient, a tool or turn-end hook or `hide inbox` brings it instead, and at its deadline it ends delivered without a receipt. An older build drops the field at its next save.

immediate.description: Sent with `hide request send --now`: delivered at the recipient's next safe gap while it works, without the mid-turn wait (PRD letters-to-busy-agents D-05). An older build drops the field at its next save, and the letter then waits as any other.

input_noticed.description: The bell whose unconfirmed notice the sender was sent, 0 for none.

input_noticed_at_unix_ms.description: When that notice was sent, 0 for none.

intake_from.description: Where the letter's wait for intake began: on its recipient machine's clock while the ledger keeps one (`Ledger::node_clocks`), on the wall clock otherwise; null is its creation on the wall clock.

tool_handovers.description: How many tool events handed the letter over while its recipient worked (PRD letters-to-busy-agents D-11): a handover is confirmed by the script once the host kept it, and after three unconfirmed ones the letter waits for the next prompt or `hide inbox`, as it does after three bells.

SendRoute.description: How an input was last sent, which decides whether Hide may send it again and what its unconfirmed notice says (`docs/delivery.md`, The input ladder).

oneOf.description: Typed into the pane: something on its screen may have taken it, so it is typed again once someone answered that screen.
Carried by the agent's start as its prompt argument (`AgentApi::LaunchPrompt`): the CLI holds it through its own start screens and submits it after them.
A queue send saved by an earlier build. Keep its receipt and never type it again: the queue can still deliver it after this upgrade.
The send's answer was lost: it may have arrived.

folded.description: Per sender, the older letters the bundle folded, oldest first; each opens with `hide request show <id>`.

letters.description: The letters shown in full, grouped by sender.

returned.description: The caller's own letters that went undelivered, returned to it: each names the recipient that did not get it, and `bell_failure` why its last bell failed when one did.

value_types.approval: not blank, at most 256 bytes, no control characters
value_types.json: a JSON document of the shape hide mission help or hide task help shows
